text: A totem carved from a tribe's Mark. Beside a Pulse Resonator it is an **extra voice**, counted for the tribe rather than for its element, so it adds Pulse even where that element already sings.
It never goes quiet, and it lends its tribe's voice to any station nearby.

pages.title: Earning the Mark
text: Raise your standing with a tribe to **Voice (800)**, then talk to that tribe's Elder. The Elder presses a **Tribe Mark** into your hand. Each tribe gives its Mark only once.
The Mark carries the tribe's name and its saying. Earning it also opens that tribe's page in this book.
Guest and Friend are not enough. If you are short, trade and offer until you reach Voice; see [Tribes and standing](standing).

pages.title: Carving the totem
text: Put the Tribe Mark, the **Resonance Totem of that tribe's voice** and **two Spiritweave** anywhere in a crafting grid. The Mark is spent into the totem.

pages.title: Which totem goes with which Mark
text: - **Earth**: Pad-keepers, Grit-singers.
- **Water**: Rootbinders.
- **Fire**: Edge-walkers, Drumhearts.
- **Air**: Pattern-weavers, Colony-keepers.
- **Spirit**: Seal-carvers.
- **Loom**: Loom-stitchers.
Right-click a placed Kinship Totem to see its tribe and the voice it lends.

steps.caption: A Pulse Resonator with an Earth and a Fire totem sings two voices.
A Drumhearts' Kinship Totem adds a third voice, even though Fire is already here.
A Pad-keepers' totem adds a fourth. Each new tribe is worth 2 more Pulse a second.
A second totem from the same tribe adds nothing. The Resonator counts tribes, not blocks.

pages.title: On a Pulse Resonator
text: Every distinct tribe with a Kinship Totem within **8 blocks** counts as one more voice. Kinship Totems never go quiet, so they always count; Resonance Totems only count while Answered.
The Resonator still needs at least one **Resonance Totem** of its own. Kinship Totems alone will not start it.
A loose heap still stops at **five voices** in total. Build a [Voice Ring](voice_ring) and the cap lifts: six elements plus all nine tribes add up to **fifteen**.

pages.title: On stations and the Loom Anchor
text: Within 8 blocks of a workshop or the Loom Anchor, a Kinship Totem only **lends its tribe's element**, as if a Resonance Totem of that voice stood there. It is not a seventh voice.
Because it never goes quiet, it is a good way to keep a station's voice awake in a spot you rarely visit.

pages.title: In the Listening Pit
text: The deep, hot and rare ore bands of a [Listening Pit](listening_pit) all need a **Grit-singer Kinship Totem**, or a **Tribe Hearth**, standing inside the pattern.
Standing with the Grit-singers still sets the limit: **Kin** for the deep and hot bands, **Voice** for the rare one.

pages.text: Tribe Mark, the matching Resonance Totem and two Spiritweave, in any order.
